paper_title: Improved axion emissivity from a supernova via nucleon-nucleon bremsstrahlung
notes: Paper derives improved axion emissivity from supernova nucleon-nucleon bremsstrahlung, including corrections beyond naive OPE (pion mass, ρ-meson exchange, effective nucleon mass, multiple scattering). Main result: g_an = g_ap ≲ 6×10^-10 from SN 1987A neutrino observations (free-streaming regime, La/Lν ≲ 1 criterion). For KSVZ model with C_ap = -0.47, C_an = 0: m_a ≲ 15 meV, f_a ≳ 4×10^8 GeV. For DFSZ: m_a ≲ 15-20 meV depending on tan β. This represents ~3× relaxation vs naive OPE due to corrections. Paper also discusses trapped axion regime (g_an ≳ 10^-6) closing hadronic axion window. Mass-independent bound encoded as horizontal line spanning typical SN mass range. Coupling type is AxionNeutron because paper focuses on nucleon-nucleon bremsstrahlung with axion-nucleon coupling g_ai, and analysis treats neutrons and protons together (g_an = g_ap assumption in main results). Extraction confidence 0.85 because: (1) coupling type unambiguous from title/abstract and detailed treatment, (2) numerical limit clearly stated in text (Section 3, Eq. 3.3, Fig. 15), (3) minor uncertainty from model-dependence (KSVZ vs DFSZ) and assumption g_an = g_ap in primary bound. | selector: text over figure_vision (quality (1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 0, 0.85, 2))
